components.name: 主操作
components.css: .ds-button-primary { cursor: pointer; font: 15px 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; border-radius: 5px; transition: background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; min-height: 46px; padding: 8px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--gold, #dfc697); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f0e3c9, #dcc29a); color: var(--ink, #18232c); font-weight: 650; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #80684a42, 0 3px 10px #06111748; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--gold-light, #f1e0be); border-color: var(--gold-light, #f1e0be); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #dfc697); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 540px) { .ds-button-primary { padding-inline: 7px; font-size: 14px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: 次操作
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { cursor: pointer; font: 15px 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; border-radius: 5px; transition: background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; min-height: 46px; padding: 8px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--brass-line, #8b7855); background: var(--panel, #14242e); color: var(--paper, #f0ece1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #243945; border-color: var(--gold, #dfc697); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #dfc697); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 540px) { .ds-button-secondary { padding-inline: 7px; font-size: 14px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: 挑战
components.css: .ds-button-challenge { cursor: pointer; font: 15px 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; border-radius: 5px; transition: background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--brass-line, #8b7855); background: var(--panel-top, #10202b); color: var(--gold-light, #f1e0be); font-size: 13px; padding: 5px 11px; } .ds-button-challenge:hover { background: #273740; border-color: var(--gold, #dfc697); } .ds-button-challenge:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #dfc697); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 540px) { .ds-button-challenge { padding-inline: 6px; white-space: nowrap; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-challenge { transition: none; } }

components.name: 文字操作
components.css: .ds-button-text { cursor: pointer; font: 15px 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; border-radius: 5px; transition: background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; min-height: 44px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--gold, #dfc697); padding: 6px 0; font-size: 13px; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-text:hover { color: var(--gold-light, #f1e0be); } .ds-button-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #dfc697); outline-offset: 3px; }  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-text { transition: none; } }

components.name: 证据栏标签
components.description: 切换线索与提示、规则册、记录和笔记。
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" aria-label="牌局辅助"><button aria-pressed="true">线索与提示</button><button aria-pressed="false">规则册</button><button aria-pressed="false">记录</button><button aria-pressed="false">笔记</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr repeat(3, 1fr); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #4c5c61); background: var(--panel-top, #10202b); border-radius: 9px 9px 0 0; padding-inline: 5px; } .ds-tabs button { background: transparent; border: 0; cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted, #b4c3cc); white-space: nowrap; font: 13px 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; min-height: 46px; padding: 8px 4px; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color: var(--paper, #f0ece1); background: #223842; } .ds-tabs button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--gold-light, #f1e0be); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px var(--gold, #dfc697); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #dfc697); outline-offset: -4px; } @media (max-width: 360px) { .ds-tabs button { font-size: 12px; } }

components.name: 笔记框
components.description: 写下支持或推翻猜测的证据。
components.html: <label class="ds-note-label" for="ds-note">哪一手支持或推翻了你的猜测？</label><textarea class="ds-note" id="ds-note"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-note-label { display: block; color: var(--muted, #b4c3cc); font: 13px 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-note { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 145px; resize: vertical; background: var(--panel-top, #10202b); border: 1px solid var(--line, #4c5c61); border-radius: 4px; padding: 9px; color: var(--paper, #f0ece1); caret-color: var(--gold, #dfc697); font: 15px/1.55 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-note::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #b4c3cc); } .ds-note:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #dfc697); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
青墨色庭院、蓝灰织物和做旧黄铜细边构成牌桌。节气和节日的插画带来小面积暖光，暗牌用月牙、细环和云纹识别。

牌桌把筹码、牌面数字和行动放在稳定位置，线索与提示在相邻区域供玩家查对。标题用书法字标，规则、数字和操作使用清楚的本地字体。
keyCharacteristics: 青墨与蓝灰底色，做旧黄铜细边。
横排牌名、节令插画、日期与拆分数字。
桌面并排，手机依次呈现牌桌、操作与证据。

rules.name: The Brass Accent Rule
rules.body: 用黄铜描边界，以浅铜强调当前状态、筹码读数与主要行动。

rules.name: The Readable Number Rule
rules.body: 日期和拆分数字各占一行，拆分数字和关键筹码读数开启等宽数字特性。

dos: Do 把筹码费用直接写在相关按钮上。
Do 为暗牌保留同尺寸的统一牌背和清楚的身份标签。
donts: Don't 把牌名、日期或拆分数字画进插画资源。
